Bl.bar_b_note: Murky brown frames with no storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraphs, an invisible player creature and (on B) a camera buried in canopy.

Es.bar_b_note: B's bright sky and pale spires carry the Cloudreach mood, but sparse, empty plateaus and flat night grades (grey rain on A) sink it next to Palworld's lived-in density.

To.bar_b_note: Identical to Es: sky identity on B, but empty settlements and flat nights fall short of Palworld's finish.

Qr.bar_b_note: B's frame, cap and stone footing read as built, but flat infill, a thin lone slab and a placeholder boulder sit below Palworld's base-building finish.

Jl.bar_b_note: The appealing stylised face, clear eyes and natural costume palette sit at Palworld's character finish.

Vr.bar_b_note: A's faint poses float; B grounds them but its noisy realistic mottling loses the designed silhouette.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight framing: purple storm grade with lightning, rim-lit fighters, fade occluding trunks, physical telegraphs with impacts, slimmer HUD
Cloudreach settlements: dress foregrounds with fences, planters, carts and NPCs, cluster buildings, warm lamp pools and lit windows over a darker base at night on B's bright-sky day
Rim-lit colour-block serpent material on grounded faints; textured plank or wattle infill with real thickness on the homestead wall
